entries.boundary: Bulk App Configuration provider load, before optional versus required consumers
entries.reason: Existing startup distinguishes remote availability from required-value validity: load failures disable remote keys while explicit environment/default consumers may proceed and missing required values still fail. The SDK/provider/key-vault pipeline is not confined to one Azure transport exception type. Authentication remains a preceding distinct fatal-startup classification, not this recovery path.
entries.diagnostic_path: Warning identifies provider unavailability and exception class only, without exception text or traceback; disabled=true and empty remote keys expose unavailable state. This is not an audit side effect or a successful remote load.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; exact compatibility evidence and necessity do not grant an exemption.

entries.boundary: Optional vector enrichment before the existing keyword retrieval request
entries.reason: The injected async embedding callable has no provider-specific exception restriction. Existing retrieval remains usable as keyword search when embedding fails, retaining query, conversation filter and delegated authorization. This does not convert a failed Search request into success.
entries.diagnostic_path: Explicit keyword-fallback warning with exception class only. No raw exception or traceback; cancellation propagates before Search is called.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this exact optional-enrichment proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Context-provider SDK search, asynchronous result iteration and context shaping
entries.reason: This optional provider contributes no grounding on failure while CompositeContextProvider retains independent sibling context. SDK, iterator and shaping failures are not a single transport exception family. Preserve this existing provider contract rather than applying the connector's distinct strict-mode policy.
entries.diagnostic_path: SOURCE_REJECTED audit event plus existing classified retrieval marker, duration and exception class, without exception text/traceback. Empty Context is not a successful Search result; cancellation propagates and SDK context cleanup receives the original cancellation.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; inner OBO recovery is a separate unapproved site, not covered by this proposal.

entries.boundary: Classic Search connector retrieval result envelope, after delegated request inputs
entries.reason: Existing strict mode must propagate the identical failure; explicit anonymous mode returns results=[], original query and error=search_failed. Configuration, embedding, authentication, HTTP and shaping failures are not confined to an SDK exception type. This is primary-work failure translation, not best-effort audit or an error-free empty result.
entries.diagnostic_path: SOURCE_REJECTED and existing auth/generic retrieval marker and severity; exception class only, no exception text/traceback. Strict re-raise or explicit anonymous error envelope preserves the distinct public outcomes.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; narrower OBO diagnostics and other connector entrypoints remain separate review work.

entries.boundary: Audit environment metadata lookup, after AuditSettings configuration
entries.reason: A failed optional environment label must not change the primary operation or audit settings.
entries.diagnostic_path: Audit event environment is the constant unknown; no configuration value is exposed.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Audit event exporter and logging handlers
entries.reason: The existing audit contract isolates exporter failures from the primary operation and reserves a constant-safe failure event.
entries.diagnostic_path: AuditEmitter._emit_failure(EXPORT_FAILURE), bounded omitted-event accounting and fixed warning fallback.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Export of the reserved audit-emission-failed event

entries.boundary: Last-resort warning sink after both audit exports fail
entries.reason: There is no further safe diagnostic sink. Re-raising would violate the existing best-effort audit contract.

entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Audited tool invocation
entries.reason: Record a failed tool event for any tool exception while preserving the original exception; this is not a best-effort primary operation.
entries.diagnostic_path: TOOL_FAILED audit event with constant failure classification followed by a bare re-raise.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Audit-only configuration reads
entries.reason: An unavailable optional audit configuration provider retains disabled audit and sensitive-content defaults; it does not change application authentication or configuration.

entries.boundary: Preparing and consuming a bounded custom container in audit content
entries.reason: Arbitrary custom mappings/sequences may fail during iteration setup or after partial progress. Discard the failed container without exposing partial data; the existing finally releases cycle-detection state. Redundant inner recovery was removed without weakening the single enclosing boundary.
entries.diagnostic_path: The entire failed path is recorded in omitted_fields; no partially processed payload is emitted.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Reading existing omitted/truncated-field bookkeeping
entries.reason: Malformed bookkeeping containers must not bypass sanitization or turn optional audit processing into a primary-operation failure.

entries.boundary: Runtime-neutral turn stream consuming the classic strategy stream
entries.reason: Unknown strategy exceptions must emit the existing generic typed error after pending events and then propagate unchanged. Narrowing to a fixed exception list would omit the required terminal error for other strategy failures; this is not successful recovery.
entries.diagnostic_path: TurnErrorEvent serializes to the existing constant-safe SSE error, followed by a bare re-raise to the caller. This handler does not log or serialize exception content.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Orchestration terminal outcome across runtime strategy implementations
entries.reason: Arbitrary strategy failures require failed audit outcome and safe span status before unchanged propagation. A provider-specific tuple cannot cover all strategy failures. Cancellation remains a distinct preceding handler.
entries.diagnostic_path: Constant internal_error span status; outcome.rejected and request.failed audit records; automatic exception/span-description capture disabled for this enclosing span. No global provider telemetry guarantee.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; parent implemented the bounded runtime correction, not an active handler exemption.

entries.boundary: Conversation-list HTTP response after authenticated principal resolution
entries.reason: Query and response construction can fail outside one provider exception family. The established HTTP contract translates all such primary failures to a generic 500, never an empty successful list. Authorization is resolved before this handler and cancellation is not caught.
entries.diagnostic_path: Bounded operation and exception-class log; fixed Error retrieving conversations HTTP detail. No query/provider exception text or traceback.

entries.boundary: Conversation-detail HTTP response after authenticated principal resolution
entries.reason: Unexpected connector or response-construction failures require the existing generic 500. Explicit not-found and foreign-principal HTTP errors retain their separate preceding propagation handler. This does not approve or redesign the connector's legacy SDK-error-to-unavailable mapping.
entries.diagnostic_path: Bounded operation and exception-class log; fixed Error retrieving conversation HTTP detail. Cancellation propagates without being translated.

entries.reason: Unexpected read, mutation or response-construction failures require the existing generic 500 rather than success. Explicit 400/403/404/500 domain HTTP errors remain unchanged in the preceding handler. A provider-only tuple cannot cover response construction failures.

entries.boundary: Hosted typed turn stream consuming a selected runtime strategy
entries.reason: Unknown strategy failures must emit the existing generic typed terminal error before unchanged propagation. A provider-specific exception tuple cannot cover all selected strategies. Cancellation remains a separate typed event and unchanged propagation, not success.
entries.diagnostic_path: Generic TurnErrorEvent without raw exception data; direct caller retains the original failure. Hosted transport separately deduplicates the error. No strategy-internal diagnostic guarantee.

entries.boundary: Already-started hosted Responses API SSE transport
entries.reason: HTTP status cannot change once streaming begins. Arbitrary strategy initialization or stream failures require the existing generic terminal error frame, deduplicated when the typed stream already emitted it. Successful closing frames must not follow failure; missing call context and cancellation retain their separate outcomes.
entries.diagnostic_path: Constant bounded internal_error log and one generic SSE error frame, without raw exception/traceback. No claim about strategy-internal or SDK telemetry.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this exact boundary proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Chat-client cleanup after MCP strategy execution
entries.reason: Cleanup must not replace an existing model failure or task cancellation, including when cleanup itself is cancelled. Without a primary exception, the identical cleanup failure must propagate after request-status telemetry. Catching only Exception would let cleanup cancellation mask the primary outcome. This is cleanup priority, not successful primary-work recovery.
entries.diagnostic_path: Constant bounded suppressed-cleanup error log; request_status remains error/cancelled for the original failure, or error for cleanup-only failure. No raw chained exception log; strategy/SDK span behavior is outside this proposal.
entries.review: Pending independent maintainer approval in Azure/gpt-rag-orchestrator#346; this exact cleanup proposal grants no permission.

entries.boundary: Already-started classic SSE response consuming typed orchestration events
entries.reason: HTTP status cannot be replaced once streaming begins. Unknown failures must terminate with the existing generic error frame, deduplicated when stream_turn already emitted it, rather than raw assistant text or an unframed transport failure.
entries.diagnostic_path: Constant bounded internal_error log and exactly one existing SSE error frame; no raw exception or traceback. Cancellation propagates without an error frame.
